mca.configuration._read_this_before_usin: READ THIS BEFORE USING VILLAGER AI
Read the setup guide before enabling AI-powered villager conversations.
mca.configuration.addContentGloballyPerm: Permission level required to add or remove skins from the server-wide pool.
mca.configuration.adventurerAtInnChanceP: Adventurer At Inn Chance Per Minute
Chance (0-1) per minute that an adventurer arrives at the inn.
mca.configuration.adventurerStayTime.too: Duration (in ticks) that adventurers stay at the inn.
mca.configuration.allowAnyNightOwl.toolt: Allows all villagers to potentially become night owls.
mca.configuration.allowBodyCustomization: Whether body customization (e.g., height, size) is available in the Destiny editor.
mca.configuration.allowDestinyCommandMor: Allow Destiny Command More Than Once
Allows the player to modify their Destiny multiple times via command.
mca.configuration.allowDestinyCommandOnc: Allows the player to modify their Destiny once via command.
mca.configuration.allowDestinyTeleportat: Players can teleport to Destiny locations.
Allows full access to the player editor including clothing and hair.
mca.configuration.allowGrimReaper.toolti: Allows summoning of the Grim Reaper entity.
mca.configuration.allowLimitedPlayerEdit: Allows limited access to player editor (name, gender, etc.).
mca.configuration.allowPlayerMarriage.to: Allow players to marry each other.
mca.configuration.allowPlayerSizeAdjustm: Allow players to modify their size.
mca.configuration.allowTraitCustomizatio: Whether trait customization is available in the Destiny editor.
mca.configuration.allowVillagerTeleporti: If true, allows stuck villagers to teleport to a safe location. Disabled by default as it can cause villagers to disappear unexpectedly.
mca.configuration.allowedSpawnReasons.to: List of allowed spawn reasons for villager conversion.
mca.configuration.archerArrowsIgnoreVill: If true, arrows fired by MCA archers pass through villagers instead of hitting them.
mca.configuration.archerEquipment.toolti: Equipment used by archers at each village equipment level.
mca.configuration.autoDiscoverDestinyLoc: Automatically adds registered village structures to the Destiny screen.
mca.configuration.babyItemGrowUpTime.too: Time (in ticks) until a baby grows up when held as an item.
mca.configuration.babyZombieChance.toolt: Chance (0-1) that a spawned zombie will be a baby zombie.
mca.configuration.baseGiftMoodEffect.too: Base mood effect of a gift, independent of previous gifts.
mca.configuration.bountyHunterHearts.too: Negative heart threshold for bounty hunter attacks.
mca.configuration.bountyHunterInterval.t: Interval (in ticks) at which bounty hunters attack the player if reputation is low.
mca.configuration.bouquetHeartsRequireme: Number of hearts required to give a bouquet to a villager.
mca.configuration.burnedClothingTickLeng: Duration (in ticks) that burned clothing effects remain visible.
mca.configuration.bypassTraitRestriction: Allows players to bypass restrictions on traits that are normally blocked in the player editor.
mca.configuration.canHurtBabies.tooltip: If true, players can damage baby villagers.
mca.configuration.childInitialHearts.too: Number of hearts a child starts with towards their parent.
mca.configuration.coloredHairChance.tool: Chance (0-1) that a villager will spawn with colored hair.
mca.configuration.defaultHeadstoneType.t: The type of headstone that automatically spawns when a villager dies.
mca.configuration.destinyDimensionBlackl: Removes Destiny destinations from matching dimensions after Minecraft determines where they can generate.
mca.configuration.destinyLocationsToTran: Maps Destiny locations to translation keys for UI text.
mca.configuration.destinyOverworldOnly.t: Restricts dimension-bound Destiny destinations to the Overworld.
mca.configuration.destinySpawnLocationBl: Removes matching locations from the Destiny screen after manual and automatic locations are combined.
Locations where the Destiny feature can teleport the player. Wiki
mca.configuration.elevenlabsFemaleVoices: List of female voice IDs for ElevenLabs TTS.
mca.configuration.elevenlabsMaleVoices.t: List of male voice IDs for ElevenLabs TTS.
mca.configuration.enableAutoScanByDefaul: If true, automatically scan for buildings. High CPU usage.
mca.configuration.enableGenderCheckForPl: Check for matching gender when trying to marry a villager.
mca.configuration.enableInfection.toolti: Enables the villager infection system. Infected villagers can turn into zombie villagers after some time.
mca.configuration.enableMourning.tooltip: Enables personal and ambient villager mourning at occupied graves.
mca.configuration.enableOnlineTTS.toolti: Enables online TTS (text-to-speech) for villager dialogue.
mca.configuration.enablePlayerShaders.to: Enables shader locations mapping for players.
mca.configuration.enableVillagerChatAI.t: Enables the AI chat for villagers.
mca.configuration.enableVillagerCollisio: If true, MCA villagers physically push each other while colliding. Climbing MCA villagers never receive entity collision pushes.
mca.configuration.enableVillagerMailingP: Enables MCA villagers to send letters or mail to players.
mca.configuration.enableVillagerPlayerMo: Player can select the villager model.
mca.configuration.enabledTraits.tooltip: Map of enabled traits. Keys are trait IDs, values are true/false.
mca.configuration.engagementHeartsRequir: Number of hearts required to get engaged to a villager.
mca.configuration.enterVillageNotificati: Whether to show notifications when entering a village.
mca.configuration.femaleVillagerHeightFa: Height scaling factor for female villagers.
mca.configuration.femaleVillagerWidthFac: Width scaling factor for female villagers.
mca.configuration.forceVillagerPlayerMod: Forces the player model to look like a villager.
mca.configuration.fractionOfVanillaVilla: Fraction (0-1) of villages left as vanilla villages.
mca.configuration.geneticImmigrantChance: Fraction (0-1) of villagers who will have biome-independent skin tones.
mca.configuration.giftDesaturationExpone: Exponent applied to desaturation formula; reduces impact of expensive gifts.
mca.configuration.giftDesaturationFactor: Factor controlling how much repeated gifts lose effectiveness.
mca.configuration.giftDesaturationQueueL: Number of entries in the gift desaturation queue.
Time (in ticks) after which gift desaturation resets.
mca.configuration.giftMoodEffect.tooltip: How much a gift influences a villager's mood.
mca.configuration.giftSatisfactionFactor: Factor multiplying the satisfaction value to determine heart impact from gifts.
mca.configuration.giveAdvancementBooks.t: If true, MCA book rewards are granted from advancements.
mca.configuration.greetAfterDays.tooltip: Number of in-game days after which villagers begin greeting the player.
mca.configuration.greetHeartsThreshold.t: Number of hearts required for a villager to greet the player.
mca.configuration.guardEquipment.tooltip: Equipment used by guards at each village equipment level.
mca.configuration.guardSpawnFraction.too: Fraction (0-1) of villagers that spawn as guards.
mca.configuration.guardsTargetEntities.t: Map of entity names to guard attack priorities. Negative values indicate the entity should be ignored.
mca.configuration.guardsTargetMonsters.t: If true, guards will attack all monsters (including modded ones). May cause guards to attack neutral mobs depending on configuration.
mca.configuration.heartsForPardonHit.too: For every X hearts, players may hit a villager once without guards attacking them.
mca.configuration.heartsRequiredToAutoSp: Hearts Required To Auto Spawn Gravestone
Minimum hearts required for a villager to automatically appear on a tombstone when they die. Family members always appear regardless of this threshold.
mca.configuration.heartsToBeConsideredAs: Hearts To Be Considered As Friend
The number of hearts required for a villager to consider the player a friend.
mca.configuration.immersiveLibraryUrl.to: URL for the immersive skin library.
mca.configuration.infectionChanceDecreas: Reduction in infection chance per villager trading level.
mca.configuration.infectionTime.tooltip: Duration (in ticks) until a villager turns into a zombie after infection. 20 ticks = 1 second; 72000 ticks = 1 hour.
mca.configuration.innArrivalNotification: Whether to show notifications when a visitor arrives at the inn.
mca.configuration.innSpawnsAdventurers.t: If true, the inn spawns adventurers.
mca.configuration.innSpawnsCultists.tool: If true, the inn spawns cultists.
mca.configuration.innSpawnsWanderingTrad: If true, the inn spawns wandering traders.
mca.configuration.interactionChanceFatig: Amount of interaction fatigue gained per interaction. Each fatigue point makes the next interaction harder.
mca.configuration.interactionFatigueCool: Time (in ticks) before fatigue resets after interacting with a villager.
mca.configuration.launchIntoDestiny.tool: Launches a player into Destiny feature when they first join.
mca.configuration.list.empty: No entries yet. Use Add New Element to create one.
mca.configuration.maleVillagerHeightFact: Height scaling factor for male villagers.
mca.configuration.maleVillagerWidthFacto: Width scaling factor for male villagers.
mca.configuration.marriageChancePerMinut: Chance (0-1) per minute that a marriage event occurs in the village.
mca.configuration.marriageHeartsRequirem: Number of hearts required to marry a villager.
mca.configuration.maxBuildingRadius.tool: Maximum radius of a building from its center.
mca.configuration.maxTreeHeight.tooltip: Maximum tree height for chopping chores.
mca.configuration.maxTreeTicks.tooltip: Maximum ticks for valid tree log blocks before they are considered grown.
mca.configuration.minPillarHeight.toolti: Minimum pillar height for Grim Reaper altars.
mca.configuration.minimumBuildingsToBeCo: Minimum Buildings To Be Considered A Village
Minimum number of buildings required to consider an area a village. Below this, it is considered a settlement and welcome notifications are suppressed.
mca.configuration.moddedVillagerWhitelis: A whitelist of modded villagers to be converted into MCA villagers.
mca.configuration.moddedZombieVillagerWh: Whitelist of modded zombie villagers to be converted into MCA zombie villagers.
mca.configuration.nameTagDistance.toolti: Maximum distance at which name tags are visible.
mca.configuration.nightOwlChance.tooltip: Fraction (0-1) of villagers who are night owls (awake at night, asleep during the day).
mca.configuration.onlineTTSServer.toolti: URL of the online TTS server.
mca.configuration.overwriteAllZombiesWit: Overwrite All Zombies With Zombie Villagers
Overwrite all zombies (not just zombie villagers) with MCA zombie villagers. May cause unpredictable behavior.
mca.configuration.overwriteOriginalVilla: Overwrite newly spawned vanilla villagers with MCA villagers. If set to false, original villagers will remain unchanged.
mca.configuration.overwriteOriginalZombi: Overwrite vanilla zombie villagers with MCA zombie villagers.
mca.configuration.pardonPlayerTicks.tool: Time (in ticks) before a player's pardon resets after hitting a villager.
mca.configuration.playerRendererBlacklis: Player renderer elements that can be disabled for certain mods. Supported values: arms, left_arm, right_arm, all, block_player, block_villager
mca.configuration.procreationCooldown.to: Time (in ticks) before villagers can procreate again.
mca.configuration.professionConversionsM: Maps modded professions to MCA professions for clothing conversion. Only adult clothing is used; toddlers and children remain unchanged.
mca.configuration.read_only: Server-owned setting: read-only on multiplayer clients
mca.configuration.remote.title: MCA Settings
mca.configuration.restart.game.tooltip: Requires restarting Minecraft before the new value takes effect.
mca.configuration.restart.world.tooltip: Requires leaving and reopening the world/server before the new value takes effect.
mca.configuration.scaleEyeHeightWithPlay: Scale Eye Height With Player Height
Moves the player's eye height according to their in-game height. Does not change hitbox size.
mca.configuration.scalePlayerHitboxWithS: Scale Player Hitbox With Size And Width
Scale player hitboxes using MCA size and width genetics.
mca.configuration.search.tooltip: Search setting names, descriptions and values (including list entries)
mca.configuration.shaderLocationsMap.too: Maps traits to shader locations, applied to players when camera entity has the trait. Requires enablePlayerShaders to be true.
mca.configuration.showNameTags.tooltip: If true, shows villager name tags above their heads.
mca.configuration.showNotificationsAsCha: If true, all notifications (village entry, marriage, birth, etc.) are shown in the chat instead of above the hotbar.
mca.configuration.structuresInRumors.too: Structures that can be mentioned in Rumors conversation options.
mca.configuration.taxSeason.tooltip: Interval (in ticks) between tax collection seasons.
mca.configuration.taxesFactor.tooltip: Multiplier of taxes paid by villages.
mca.configuration.taxesMap.tooltip: Map of tax items to their value in units. If item is too expensive, it may not be picked until tax budget is sufficient.
mca.configuration.title: %s Configuration
Tracks villager positions for debugging or AI purposes. Slightly increases world size and CPU overhead.
mca.configuration.trackVillagerPositionE: Track Villager Position Every N Ticks
Number of ticks between position tracking updates for villagers.
mca.configuration.traitChance.tooltip: Chance multiplier (0-1) of a villager having one trait.
mca.configuration.traitInheritChance.too: Chance multiplier (0-1) of a child inheriting a parent's personality trait.
mca.configuration.twinBabyChance.tooltip: Fraction (0-1) of babies that are born as twins.
mca.configuration.unSafeBlocksToTeleport: List of blocks or tags that villagers will not teleport onto.
mca.configuration.useMCAVoices.tooltip: Enables MCA villager voice lines. Set to false to mute all villager sounds.
Use the USA name set instead of international names.
mca.configuration.useSmarterDoorAI.toolt: Enables smarter villager door AI, allowing them to open gates as well.
mca.configuration.useSquidwardModels.too: If true, villagers use the vanilla "Squidward" (nose) model.
mca.configuration.useVanillaVoices.toolt: If true, villagers use vanilla Minecraft voice sounds instead of MCA custom voices.
mca.configuration.validTreeSources.toolt: List of valid blocks that can serve as the base of trees.
mca.configuration.validation.discard.mes: This list contains invalid entries. Leaving now will discard this editing session, including valid changes.
mca.configuration.validation.registry: Not found in the current registry
mca.configuration.villagerBirthNotificat: Whether to show notifications when a villager gives birth.
mca.configuration.villagerChatAIContextP: Villager Chat AI Context Permission Level
Permission level required to edit ChatAI context prompts.
mca.configuration.villagerChatAIEndpoint: Chat completion endpoint for villager AI chat requests.
mca.configuration.villagerChatAIFuseSyst: Villager Chat AI Fuse System Prompt
Prepends the system prompt to the user message for endpoints that ignore the system role.
mca.configuration.villagerChatAIIncludeS: Villager Chat AI Include Session Information
If true, session-specific information is included in AI requests. Only relevant if writing a custom backend.
mca.configuration.villagerChatAIModel.to: AI model to use for villager chat.
mca.configuration.villagerChatAISystemPr: System prompt used to guide global villager AI behavior.
mca.configuration.villagerChatAIUseLongT: Villager Chat AI Use Long Term Memory
If true, AI uses long-term memory for persistent conversations.
mca.configuration.villagerChatAIUseShare: Villager Chat AI Use Shared Long Term Memory
If false, villager will have separate memories per player.
mca.configuration.villagerChatAIUseTools: Villagers try to follow commands like "follow me", ...
mca.configuration.villagerChatPrefix.too: Prefix used in villager chat messages.
mca.configuration.villagerDimensionBlack: Dimensions where villagers should not be converted into MCA villagers.
mca.configuration.villagerHealthBonusPer: Extra health villagers gain per trading level.
mca.configuration.villagerInteractionIte: List of items that villagers cannot be interacted with for mod compat.
mca.configuration.villagerMarriageNotifi: Whether to show notifications when villagers get married.
mca.configuration.villagerMaxAgeTime.too: Maximum villager lifetime in ticks (Time to grow fully up).
mca.configuration.villagerMinTeleportati: Minimum squared distance at which teleportation becomes possible for villagers.
mca.configuration.villagerPathfindingDis: Maximum geometric path horizon used for long-range villager destinations such as beds.
mca.configuration.villagerProcreationCha: Chance (0-1) per minute that villagers will procreate.
mca.configuration.villagerRestockNotific: Whether to show notifications when a villager restocks their trades.
mca.configuration.villagerTagsHacks.tool: Injects MCA villagers into the villager tag.
mca.configuration.villagersInteractWithF: If true, MCA villagers may path through and open or close fence gates.
mca.configuration.zombieBiteInfectionCha: Chance (0-1) for infection when bitten by a zombie.
